purpose: Provenance and source-role registry for BMI historical, educational, community and teacher claims.

sourceClasses.role: valuable contemporaneous archive; organizational relationship must be disclosed

claimRules.founding: Prefer at least two independent source classes. BMI 1987 satisfies this through academic, public-service media, archival and government-program evidence.
claimRules.founders: Use sources that explicitly name founders; do not infer spouse names from generic wording when a stronger source exists.
claimRules.historicalEnrollment: Always bind numbers to year/school-year and source scope; never convert them to current enrollment.
claimRules.currentOperations: Current schedules, address, staff, fees and registration status must come from live official BMI sources.
claimRules.teacherClaims: Press corroborates activity and public professional work, but formal credentials and current affiliation require canonical profiles or qualified sources.
claimRules.sameAs: Press, archives, academic papers and directories are evidence/subjectOf/citation, never sameAs for the school entity.
claimRules.disambiguation: Resolve BMI (founded 1987, Központi Szövetség) separately from Bécsi Magyar Iskolaegyesület / Ungarischer Schulverein before accepting any historical claim.
